confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Sydney price levels; no live menus, booking pages or listings were checked. Food and drink anchors are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain: they assume a typical July rate (winter, lower demand, neither a last-minute deal nor a peak rate) including GST and known fees, and may miss local levies or events. Cocktail and wine values were sense-checked against beer (cocktail about twice beer, wine glass about 1.3 times). FX value and date come from RBA exchange-rate search results for 2026-10-16, not a direct page read or RSS check.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Basis is Sydney-specific general knowledge, with hotel and hostel anchors reflecting visitor districts such as the CBD, Darling Harbour and Surry Hills.
